features: Reflex Memory Cache: Zero-latency navigation by caching successful UI click sequences and re-applying them without vision processing.
Multi-Agent Delegation: Spawns isolated background sub-agents to handle long-running web tasks parallel to the main conversation.
Continuous Dreaming: Background idle simulation loop that explores interfaces and learns new web skills while the system is inactive.
Agentic Vision Workflow: System-injected vision navigation for precise, popup-resilient application driving instead of blind keystrokes.
Character: a consistent J.A.R.V.I.S. manner on every brain, with a configurable form of address (persona.character and persona.address).
Recurring tasks: schedule_task now saves schedules, survives a restart, runs each one as a tracked background agent, never overlaps a run, and can be listed and cancelled.
Agent teams: every agent has its own time budget, Verify waits for the reports it audits, and a specialist's partial report no longer blocks the rest of the team.

Reliability: a new command no longer inherits a false "connection closed" from the previous Claude session, a temporary Gemini fallback no longer replaces the chosen model, and tasks left running by a crash are closed at the next start.
Background helpers (ghost, shadow, auto-debug) use the configured local model and host.
Runtime: Electron 33 to 45 (Chromium 130 to 156, Node 20 to 24). Echo now needs macOS 13 or later.
Faster replies on Claude: the next session is started while you are still reading the last answer, about 1.4 seconds sooner to the first word in measurement. Turn off with claude.keepWarm.
Updated AI SDKs for Claude, Gemini, OpenAI and MCP, with the Gemini API version pinned so the update changes nothing unasked.
TypeScript 7 (the native compiler) and esbuild 0.28: the typecheck runs in about 1.5 seconds instead of 8.
